description: This file defines a migration class for database schema updates related to the 'Buzz' or social feed module in the OrangeHRM system, version 4.4.0. It includes methods to create tables, add foreign keys, insert configuration settings, and set up module menu entries specific to the Buzz feature.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines database migration steps for setting up the Buzz feature's schema, configuration, and menu integration in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration, creating database tables, foreign keys, inserting configurations, and menu setup for the Buzz module in version 4.4.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.4' indicating the schema version of this migration.
